labeller: Manual labels by the student (author) reading results/audit/coherence_sheet.csv. Same labeller wrote the pipeline, so bias toward B is possible.
scale: 0 = cut mid-idea / missing subject, not understandable; 1 = partly understandable, missing context or cut at an edge; 2 = self-contained, keeps the whole idea
position_rule: 10 positions fixed before labelling by src/run.py _coherence_positions: pages evenly spaced over the 77 sorted content pages; anchor = 60 chars after the page midpoint. C reuses B chunks, so C labels equal B labels.
